summary: Defines the Call Processing Language, a simple, extensible language for describing and controlling Internet telephony services. It is designed to run on servers or user agents, be easy for graphical tools to edit, and be independent of signaling protocol.

eli5.summary: It is a way to write simple call rules, such as "if my boss calls, ring me." Even a drawing program could produce the rules.

questions: how to script sip call handling
